papers.title_en: Image Diffusion Models Are Good 3D Human Motion Generators
papers.authors: Siyuan Yang, Chong Wang, Hao Cheng, Jun Liu, Bihan Wen, Alex Kot, Hedvig Kjellstrom
papers.evidence: 图像扩散模型作为三维人体动作生成器
papers.tldr: 文本到运动生成常受限于数据集特定的骨架表示，不同关节布局需分别建模。该工作把根中心关节轨迹组织成拓扑感知的关节-时间图像，并用互补潜流建模全局根动态，再以文本条件 SiT 联合生成。在 HumanML3D 和 KIT-ML 上，专用模型达到最优，共享自编码器与 SiT 训练还能进一步提升。这表明图像扩散架构可作为跨异构骨架的通用 3D 人体运动生成器。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation typically relies on dataset-specific skeletal representations, with models trained separately for benchmarks with different joint layouts. We investigate whether image diffusion architectures can model 3D human motion through a common image-compatible representation that accommodates heterogeneous skeletal layouts while preserving motion-specific kinematic structure. To this end, we organize root-centered joint trajectories into topology-informed joint--time images and model global root dynamics through a complementary latent stream. A motion autoencoder conditions local-motion decoding on the root latent, while a text-conditioned Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) jointly generates both latent streams, with supervision on decoded 3D joint positions further constraining generation in motion space. In addition to dataset-specific models, we train a single motion autoencoder on HumanML3D and KIT-ML, followed by a single text-conditioned SiT shared across both datasets, preserving their respective skeletal definitions without skeleton retargeting to a common joint layout. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show that our dataset-specific models achieve state-of-the-art performance, while shared training yields further gains on both benchmarks, demonstrating the benefits of shared modeling across heterogeneous skeletal layouts.

papers.title_en: MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow
papers.authors: Qiang He, Yonghao Zhang, Yinda Zhang, Chenyu Meng, Liufei Ouyang, Haoxiang Hu, Cangjun Gao, Xiaoming Deng, Cuixia Ma, Hongan Wang
papers.evidence: 基于MeanFlow的全身人-物交互生成
papers.tldr: 全身人-物交互生成需协调身体与手指运动、物体轨迹及时变接触，现有方法依赖迭代扩散或测试时优化，推理成本高。MFlowHOI提出一步式框架：用接触感知多部件RVQVAE构建结构化隐空间，并以ST-DiT建模时空与跨部件依赖，单次MeanFlow评估即可生成完整交互。实验结果表明，其运动质量与文本对齐优于基线，且推理时间大幅降低。该工作为高效全身HOI生成及交互保持的化身迁移提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.

papers.title_en: OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching
papers.evidence: 用于三维人体动作恢复的掩码流匹配
papers.tldr: 稀疏可穿戴传感器恢复3D人体运动常受噪声、遮挡与信号不稳定影响，现有方法又受限于固定传感器配置，扩散模型推理开销大。OmniPoser提出统一框架，以跨模态掩码和Masked Conditioning Encoder支持3D关键点、稀疏IMU、头戴6-DoF等异构输入任意组合。它用解耦双流骨干和Conditional Flow Matching，仅需单步ODE生成全身SMPL运动。在七个基准及Nymeria、Ego-Exo4D上性能媲美SOTA，推理超700 FPS，实现灵活实时的野外运动恢复。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse wearable sensors is challenging due to the inherent noise, occlusion, and instability of real-world tracking signals. Existing approaches are restricted to fixed sensor configurations and, when built on diffusion models, are computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment. We propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers full-body SMPL motion from a flexible combination of heterogeneous inputs, such as 3D keypoints, sparse IMU rotations, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, or any subset thereof, within a single model. OmniPoser introduces a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, enabling one architecture to incorporate diverse sensor configurations through a masked design. A decoupled dual-stream generative backbone generates complete motion via Conditional Flow Matching, requiring only a single ODE integration step at inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, including in-the-wild Nymeria and Ego-Exo4D datasets, OmniPoser performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. The project page is available at https://jamesbridgewater51.github.io/omniposer-eccv/.

papers.authors: Nga Kiu Kelly Ho, Yilin Liu, Hao Xu, Niloy J. Mitra
papers.evidence: 条件流匹配生成手物运动
papers.tldr: 从单一初始手-物状态生成完整4D抓取序列，对动画与具身智能很重要；现有方法多只合成最终静态抓取，或依赖语言、目标抓取、物体轨迹等额外条件。本文提出解耦框架：用条件流匹配预测序列级接触图与各归一化时刻的手部姿态，再通过无需训练的接触引导加权配准恢复刚体运动。在DexYCB与Open-CHOIR新几何上，运动更平滑，接触/穿透指标不差于LatentHOI，且每帧约快30倍；15人研究中约三分之二偏好本方法。新几何上的精确接触闭合仍是挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing believable 4D hand-object grasping sequences is important for character animation, extended reality, and embodied agents. Grasping requires a hand to approach, contact, and lift or manipulate an object coherently. Existing synthesis methods often model only the final static grasp or rely on additional conditions, such as language, target grasps, or object trajectories, to specify the interaction. We instead study the underconstrained problem of generating a complete grasping motion from a single initial hand-object state. Our framework decouples hand-motion generation from object-motion recovery. Given an object point cloud in the initial wrist frame and the initial parameterized hand configuration, conditional flow matching predicts a sequence-level contact map and a hand pose at each normalized sequence time. This time-indexed formulation avoids the error accumulation of autoregressive rollout while representing the complete motion. We then infer an attachment frame and recover rigid-object motion through training-free, contact-guided weighted registration. We evaluate on held-out DexYCB objects and unseen object geometries reconstructed from in-the-wild videos by Open-CHOIR. Compared with LatentHOI, our method produces smoother hand and object motion in every setting, matches or improves on its contact and penetration metrics in the wild under a shared initialization, and is about 30x faster per generated frame. In a 15-participant study, our motions were preferred in roughly two thirds of (forced-choice pairwise) comparisons. Precise contact closure on novel geometry, however, remains a key open challenge.

papers.title_en: ProMoDD: Dataset Distillation for 3D Human Motion via Prototype-Conditioned Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Yijin Wei, Yawen Zou, Wenqi Cai, Guang Li, Hangli Ge, Katsuya Hotta, Chunzhi Gu, Chao Zhang
papers.evidence: 动作扩散模型用于3D人体动作生成
papers.tldr: 面向骨架动作识别的数据集蒸馏需在压缩样本中保留判别性动作变化，又不能破坏人体几何与时间连续性。ProMoDD 以类级时序识别特征原型为条件驱动运动扩散模型，并定制扩散训练以同时建模骨骼构型与时间演化。它再通过预算感知的混合选择，用真实序列覆盖密集区域、生成候选补足稀疏区域。在 NTU RGB+D 60 单人类上，每类仅 3 序列时 Full49 达 40.32% top-1，较类级 k-means 高 4.57 个百分点，且蒸馏集可跨 ST-GCN、MS-G3D、CTR-GCN 复用。
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to retain the training utility of a large dataset in a much smaller set of examples. For skeleton-based action recognition, this requires capturing discriminative motion variation without disrupting the geometry and temporal continuity of articulated bodies. Directly optimizing joint coordinates can violate these constraints, while plausible motion generation alone does not ensure useful training examples. We propose Prototype-Conditioned Motion Dataset Distillation (ProMoDD), which conditions a motion diffusion model on class-wise prototypes of temporally resolved recognition features. We further tailor diffusion training to motion data, enabling the generator to model both skeletal configurations and their temporal evolution. We then construct each compact training set through budget-aware hybrid selection: representative real sequences cover densely populated regions of the pooled recognition space, while selected generated candidates complement them in less-populated regions. This couples prototype-guided generation with feature-space selection, balancing the reliability of observed motions with the variation of synthesis under a fixed per-class sequence budget. Across five difficulty-stratified subsets of the single-person classes in NTU RGB+D 60, ProMoDD achieves its largest gains under tight distillation budgets, reaching 40.32% top-1 accuracy on Full49 with three sequences per class, 4.57 percentage points above class-wise k-means. These gains reflect the complete framework. The same distilled sets train ST-GCN, MS-G3D, and CTR-GCN without regeneration.

papers.title_en: Walk Like This: Stylized Locomotion for Physics-Based Characters through Example-Driven Diffusion
papers.authors: Joshua Aurand, Agon Serifi, Sammy Christen, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Marco Hutter, Moritz Bächer
papers.evidence: 扩散模型风格化运动生成
papers.tldr: 面向物理角色，现有数据驱动控制器通常依赖显式风格标签，难以利用大规模无结构动作数据并泛化到未见风格。本文提出实时风格化运动框架，用定制采样训练风格编码器，将风格与功能性运动解耦，并以自回归扩散模型生成受风格条件约束的运动学参考。推理时用户给出风格片段和摇杆速度指令，RL控制器跟踪参考，配合注意力偏置与速度指令校正提升可控性和风格强度。在仿真人形与实体机器人上实现鲁棒实时控制和连续风格调制。
papers.abstract_en: We present a real-time framework for expressive legged locomotion that enables independent control over velocity and style. Unlike existing data-driven controllers, which typically require explicit style labels for training, our method efficiently leverages large-scale unstructured motion data and generalizes to unseen styles. We disentangle style from functional locomotion through a tailored sampling strategy used to train a style encoder whose output conditions an autoregressive diffusion model. During inference, the user provides a style reference clip and a joystick velocity command. The diffusion model then generates a kinematic reference tracked by a reinforcement learning controller. To improve user controllability and stylization strength, we propose an attention biasing mechanism and a velocity command correction strategy. We demonstrate our method on a physics-based humanoid character in simulation and on a physical robot, showcasing robust real-time control and continuous style modulation. The results can be best seen in our supplemental video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=roFnS6N7nJ4).

papers.title_en: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
papers.authors: Yuxiang Fu, Qi Yan, Zike Wu, Yongxing Zhang, Purang Abolmaesumi, Lele Wang, Renjie Liao
papers.evidence: 加速扩散与流模型的无数据蒸馏方法
papers.tldr: 扩散与流模型因数值积分昂贵而推理缓慢，现有蒸馏依赖数据集、教师轨迹或代理网络。本文提出一致性分布匹配（CDM），用单个学生网络统一样本生成与得分估计，仅需冻结教师与可训练学生，优化单一无模拟、无数据目标。理论上其目标最小化可令学生流映射推前分布 Wasserstein 收敛到教师边缘分布。在 ImageNet 256×256 上，40 轮内取得 1-NFE FID 2.04、4-NFE FID 1.37，超越无数据蒸馏基线。
papers.abstract_en: Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher's dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. In this work, we propose Consistent Distribution Matching, a simulation-free and data-free distillation method for accelerating diffusion and flow models while preserving strong generative capacity. Our key insight is to unify sample generation and score estimation with one student network. Thus, our framework uses only two models, a frozen teacher and a trainable student, and optimizes one objective. We prove that minimizing our objective indicates Wasserstein convergence of the student flow-map pushforwards to the teacher marginals. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, our method attains an FID of 2.04 with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 within 40 epochs of training, surpassing the state-of-the-art distillation baselines without data. Our code code and model are available at https://consistentdmd.github.io/.

papers.title_en: StimFlow: Synthesizing Brain Activity from Images via Stimulus-conditioned Flow Matching
papers.authors: Bui Van Hung, Dang Thanh Vu, Hoang-Son Vo, Mai Duc Minh Huy, Mai Tien Dung, Soo-Hyung Kim
papers.tldr: fMRI响应存在跨试次变异，传统生成编码器多在压缩潜空间并主要依赖语义条件，难以为早期视觉皮层提供低层线索。StimFlow在原生体素空间用线性路径的条件流匹配直接合成fMRI，并对齐训练与推理分布。它融合DINOv2结构特征与CLIP语义特征，单样本即达逐体素Pearson 0.371，媲美五次平均基线。该方法支持无需解码器的ROI分析与概念定位，仅一小时扫描可恢复过半全数据性能，助力跨被试适配。
papers.abstract_en: The inherent variability of fMRI responses across trials encourages a generative view of the stimulus-to-response mapping. Prior generative encoders often operate in compressed latent spaces and condition predominantly on semantic features, which provide limited low-level cues for early visual cortex. We propose StimFlow, which synthesizes fMRI directly in native voxel space using conditional flow matching with a linear path. This design aligns training and inference distributions, enabling competitive performance with a single sample and reducing reliance on averaging. To match the visual hierarchy, StimFlow combines structural DINOv2 features with semantic CLIP features, which prove complementary along the cortical processing stream. With a single sample, StimFlow achieves a per-voxel Pearson correlation of 0.371, matching baselines that average five draws. Generation in voxel space allows direct ROI analysis and concept localization without a decoder. Furthermore, it recovers over half of full-data performance from just one hour of scans, supporting efficient cross-subject adaptation.

papers.title_en: Learning $ω$-Powered Conditional Distributions with Importance-Weighted Flow Matching
papers.authors: Maciej Falkiewicz, Frantzeska Lavda, Jason Ramapuram, Alexandros Kalousis
papers.evidence: 重要性加权条件流匹配
papers.tldr: 无分类器引导（CFG）常被视为采样 ω 次方条件分布，但当引导尺度 γ 等于 ω 时，CFG 通常并不能精确采样该目标分布。本文提出重要性加权条件流匹配（IW-CFM），利用冻结的条件流与无条件流模型估计密度比，对条件流匹配样本重新加权，从而显式学习 powered 条件分布。在合成分布上，IW-CFM 能恢复解析 powered 目标，而数值匹配的 CFG 仍出现可见偏差；在 ImageNet 上，轻量校正器取得比固定引导和匹配引导 CFG 更好的对齐。该工作为研究并逼近模型定义的 powered 条件分布提供了实用路线。
papers.abstract_en: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) with guidance scale $γ$ is commonly motivated by the $ω$-powered conditional distribution obtained by setting $ω=γ$, but CFG does not, in general, sample from this distribution exactly. We study whether the powered target can instead be learned explicitly. We introduce Importance-Weighted Conditional Flow Matching (IW-CFM), which reweights conditional flow-matching examples using density ratios obtained from frozen conditional and unconditional flow models. With exact normalized weights, the resulting objective has the same gradient as flow matching on the powered target; in practice, we use self-normalized estimation and a regularized empirical approximation for high-dimensional data. On synthetic distributions, IW-CFM recovers analytical powered targets for which numerically matched CFG, $γ=ω$, exhibits a visible mismatch. On ImageNet, an amortized lightweight corrector achieves better alignment than fixed- and matched-guidance CFG with the corresponding weighted and filtered reference distributions. We additionally present an exploratory CLIP analysis of powered-density rankings on real ImageNet data. Aggregate shifts across selected prompt-specific contrasts coexist with heterogeneous classwise responses, including nonmonotonic trajectories. These results provide a practical route for studying and approximating model-defined powered conditional distributions.

papers.title_en: Calibrating Generative Flows through Regional Probability Matching
papers.authors: Yubo Huang, Xiongyu Hu, Xin Lai, Zixi Wang, Liao Jian, Jingzehua Xu, Chuan He
papers.evidence: 用区域概率匹配校准流匹配生成模型
papers.tldr: 1类别比例下，校正类质量误差较minibatch最优传输降低44.6%。该工作为稀有事件频率敏感的科学推断提供校准生成流。
papers.abstract_en: Generative models offer a powerful route to scientific simulation and discovery by enabling the study of complex populations and rare phenomena. Flow matching can generate realistic samples, yet inaccurate occurrence frequencies can distort population statistics and compromise inferences about rare events. Here we developed generalized mass-preserving coupled flow matching (G-MPCF), which matches the probability masses of Gaussian source regions to those of weighted data regions. This construction encodes the desired regional frequencies in the correspondence between noise and observations, shaping the learned dynamics while preserving the prescribed target distribution. On a rare-mode benchmark, G-MPCF reduces relative score error by 95.0% and numerical integration error by 89.9% compared with independent flow matching. On CIFAR-10 with a 100:1 class-probability ratio, it reduces corrected class-mass error by 44.6% compared with minibatch optimal transport, while improving mean image fidelity with matched computational budgets. We envision that incorporating regional probability calibration into generative modelling will support more reliable scientific simulation and inference, enabling the study of systems in which rare events and their occurrence frequencies are central to understanding the underlying mechanisms.

papers.title_en: MissPath-FM: Flow Matching with Structured Priors for Partially Observed Time Series
papers.tldr: 部分观测时间序列中，标准条件流匹配从无信息高斯源出发，迫使已观测值也经历噪声到目标的传输，浪费容量。MissPath-FM 重构源先验与概率路径：用插值和高斯过程后验先验让流靠近观测信号初始化，并以缺失感知平滑路径非对称分配观测区与缺失区的传输。在4数据集、4种缺失机制、2种缺失率和3种长度共48设置中，整体45/48胜出，T=48时29/32胜出。消融显示结构化先验与学习流按机制互补，观测区传输最多缩短15倍。
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has emerged as a powerful alternative to diffusion models for generative modeling, but standard conditional flow matching is fundamentally misaligned with partially observed time series: starting from an uninformed Gaussian source forces the model to transport even already-observed entries from noise to the target, wasting capacity on trivially known regions. We propose MissPath-FM, a partial-observation-aware flow matching framework that redesigns the source prior and probability path for incomplete time series. MissPath-FM employs structured source priors (interpolation priors and Gaussian process posterior priors) to initialize the flow close to the observed signal, paired with a missingness-aware smooth path that allocates transport asymmetrically between observed and missing regions. We evaluate systematically across four datasets, four missingness mechanisms (MCAR, block, MNAR, irregular), two missing ratios, and three sequence lengths (T in {24, 48, 96}), totaling 48 settings against eight baselines. MissPath-FM wins 29 of 32 settings at T=48 and 45 of 48 overall (93.8%). Our ablations reveal a regime-dependent design hierarchy in which no single component suffices: under random missingness the source prior yields a large initial gain, but under structured block missingness it can fail entirely and the learned flow becomes indispensable; the missingness-aware path contributes a further 12%-26% across all regimes. Mechanistically, structured priors shorten observed-region transport by up to 15x, concentrating the velocity field on genuinely uncertain entries. Project page: https://zgp110.github.io/misspath-fm/

papers.evidence: 基于欧氏距离的流匹配生成建模方法
papers.tldr: Flow Matching 是近期流行的生成建模技术，在多个领域得到应用。标准 Flow Matching 将向量场视为最小二乘回归解，但该目标对数据污染较敏感。本文把平方欧氏距离替换为欧氏距离作为回归目标，并将新回归目标解释为条件几何中位数。基于稳健统计视角，作者分析该目标的数学性质与分布鲁棒性，并在特定污染设定下证明严重污染时性能提升。CIFAR-10 污染样本实验表明，欧氏距离 Flow Matching 在严重污染场景中具有明显优势。
papers.abstract_en: Flow Matching has recently become popular as a technique for generative modeling with applications in many domains. In the standard Flow Matching formulation, we interpret the vector field as the solution of a least-squares regression problem, which is known to be sensitive to contamination. Therefore we leverage the viewpoint of robust statistics and replace the squared Euclidean distance with the Euclidean distance as a regression objective. This seemingly minor change strongly affects the properties of Flow Matching. We provide a probabilistic interpretation of the new regression target as a conditional geometric median and use this characterization to study distributional robustness of the Euclidean Distance-based Flow Matching. We analyze the mathematical properties of this changed objective and the effect of a contaminated target distribution on the involved conditional velocity distributions. We discuss the challenge of directly characterizing the distribution that our method induces. In specific contamination settings we show theoretically that our method yields an improvement for severe contamination. Finally, we present numerical experiments conducted on the CIFAR-10 image dataset where a proportion of the samples has been contaminated. Our Euclidean distance-based Flow Matching shows a clear advantage in scenarios of severe contamination of the target distribution.

papers.title_en: Primal-Dual Flow Matching for Sample-Wise Constrained Generation
papers.authors: Zhengyan Huan, Peter Y. Lu, Shuchin Aeron
papers.evidence: 流匹配参数化用于受约束数据生成
papers.tldr: 生成模型需满足逐样本约束且达到指定概率，但现有方法依赖可微距离、投影或凸性。提出 Primal-Dual Flow Matching（PDFM），以流匹配参数化总体约束负对数似然最小化，用原始-对偶优化仅借二元成员预言机反馈控制约束满足率。在正则性与速度场充分表达假设下，理论给出约束满足概率保证；实验显示其较 vanilla FM 提升约束满足，并与约束感知基线竞争且保持分布保真。该工作为无需可微约束的逐样本约束生成提供了实用框架。
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning to generate data while satisfying a prescribed \emph{sample-wise} constraint with a user-specified probability of constraint satisfaction. Starting with a population-level constrained negative log-likelihood minimization and using a flow-matching (FM) parameterization, under regularity assumptions and sufficient expressivity of the velocity field family, we derive guarantees on the probability of constraint satisfaction for the corresponding primal-dual optimization algorithm. We provide a practical implementation of this approach, called Primal-Dual Flow Matching (PDFM), which has direct control over constraint satisfaction rate and requires only binary membership oracle feedback for constraint satisfaction, avoiding the need for differentiable distances, projections, or special structure of the constraint set, such as convexity. We show that PDFM improves constraint satisfaction over vanilla FM and achieves competitive performance against constraint-aware baselines while maintaining distributional fidelity. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhengyanHuan/PDFM.

papers.title_en: Learning Representations to Guide Pixel Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Zihao Pan, Mengting Chen, Cheng Shi, Taihang Hu, Zhengrong Yue, Zikang Wang, Yuan Wang, Wei Li, Sibei Yang
papers.tldr: 视觉表征多服务于理解任务，其在生成中的价值仍不明确。本文在像素扩散 Transformer 中发现，表征质量高不等于生成效用强，外部语义可能在像素合成中逐渐丢失；专用像素解码器的架构分离也只是重新分配语义与空间建模。为此提出 Representation Guidance（RG），用低维瓶颈形成紧凑内部表征，并按预测偏移修改流匹配目标来显式引导解码生成。RG 保持朴素 Transformer 架构，在 ImageNet 256 上以 459M 参数超越更大模型，XL/16 FID 1.55，512 分辨率 FID 1.74，并扩展至文本到图像，GenEval 0.89、DPG-Bench 87.1。
papers.abstract_en: Visual representations are largely developed for understanding, yet what makes them useful for generation remains unclear. We study this question in pixel diffusion transformers and uncover two key insights. First, better representation quality does not necessarily translate into greater generative utility, as externally aligned semantics can be progressively lost during pixel synthesis. Second, architectural separation with specialized pixel decoders mainly redistributes semantic and spatial modeling, without necessarily yielding representations better suited to generation. These insights suggest that a useful generative representation must be both properly formed and actively exploited. Motivated by these insights, we introduce Representation Guidance (RG), which directly forms and exploits internal representations while retaining a plain Transformer architecture. A low-dimensional bottleneck forces generation-relevant information into a compact representation, which is then explicitly used to guide decoder generation by modifying the flow-matching target according to its induced prediction offset. RG learns clearer semantic and spatial structure while scaling efficiently in both parameters and computation. On ImageNet 256x256, RG-L/16 with only 459M parameters outperforms substantially larger pixel diffusion transformers, while RG-XL/16 achieves an FID of 1.55. RG further reaches an FID of 1.74 at 512x512 and extends to text-to-image generation, achieving 0.89 on GenEval and 87.1 on DPG-Bench.

papers.title_en: A Stochastic Analysis Perspective on Diffusion Models
papers.evidence: 从随机分析视角研究基于分数的扩散生成模型
papers.tldr: 生成模型需从观测数据学习概率近似并设计可采样机制。本文从随机分析视角审视基于分数的生成模型，用分数函数连接Langevin采样与分数匹配，并借助高斯平滑导出去噪分数匹配与多尺度采样。文章强调保持固定分布与传输指定边缘分布两类动力学的区别，从而引入路径空间处理扩散时间反转。最终将理想反向扩散与实际生成算法联系起来，为扩散模型提供统一理论框架。
papers.abstract_en: Generative modelling involves two complementary tasks: learning a probabilistic approximation of an unknown data distribution from observations, and designing a tractable mechanism for sampling from this approximation. We present a stochastic-analysis perspective on score-based generative models, connecting ideas from classical sampling theory, score estimation, and diffusion time reversal. We first explain how score functions link Langevin sampling with score matching, and how Gaussian smoothing leads to denoising score matching and multiscale sampling methods. We then emphasize the distinction between dynamics preserving a fixed distribution and dynamics transporting a prescribed family of marginals. This motivates a path-space treatment of diffusion time reversal. Finally, we connect the ideal reverse diffusion with practical generative algorithms.

papers.title_en: AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation
papers.evidence: 共享LoRA参数上的流匹配梯度
papers.tldr: 视频扩散模型适配中，显式点对应能描述可见表面运动，却可能覆盖预训练外观先验。AcrossVAM2.0 在5.01B文生视频扩散Transformer上，结合置信度加权轨迹与可见性头、零初始化残差反馈和不对称PCGrad，仅移除与主flow-matching冲突的辅助梯度。1000步四路消融中，三随机种子KLT循环误差均降低，24提示216视频的CoTracker3循环误差降9.7%，但I3D-FVD从0.1824升至0.2022，说明对应一致性提升且无广泛感知退化，视频质量非一致改善。
papers.abstract_en: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.

papers.title_en: Channel Match: Calibrating Shape Latents for Few-Step 3D Generation
papers.authors: Di Yang, Zhihao Li, Yanhai Xiong, Yufei Wang
papers.tldr: 原生3D生成器用流式Transformer建模结构化3D潜变量，但高分辨率迭代采样开销大。本文提出少步蒸馏框架，结合连续自一致性训练、定制JVP FlashAttention核与解析速度回归目标，自适应加权损失。还发现少步采样引起潜分布漂移：几何仍正确却破坏PBR纹理合成，为此提出免训练逐通道潜校准Channel Match。在TRELLIS.2的1024³设置下，两步模型几何采样提速4.5倍，质量与多步教师相当，渲染质量得到恢复。
papers.abstract_en: Recent native 3D generators achieve high-quality asset creation by modeling structured 3D latents with flow-based transformers, but their high-resolution generation remains computationally expensive due to costly iterative sampling. In this work, we introduce a few-step distillation framework for native 3D generation, enabled by continuous self-consistency training with a custom JVP FlashAttention kernel and an analytic velocity regression objective for sparse structured 3D latents. To stabilize joint optimization, we further introduce an adaptive loss weighting strategy that automatically balances them without manual tuning. Beyond acceleration, we reveal a previously overlooked failure mode of few-step native 3D generation: sampling-induced latent distribution drift preserves geometric correctness but disrupts downstream PBR texture synthesis, causing texture artifacts on geometrically valid assets. To address this issue, we propose Channel Match, a training-free adaptive per-channel latent calibration method that restores the latent distribution without modifying either generator. We validate our approach on TRELLIS.2 at the $1024^3$ resolution setting. Our two-step model achieves $4.5\times$ faster geometry sampling while maintaining geometry quality comparable to the many-step teacher, and Channel Match further improves rendering quality by recovering the latent interface between geometry and appearance generation.
